item.title: Issue #001: Why Static Calculators & Verified Checklists Outconvert SaaS Bloat in 2026
item.description: How boutique agencies and DACH SMEs cut margin leakage by 15-30% using zero-macro spreadsheets, deterministic validation, and self-serve Stripe workflows. Buyers in B2B ops are fatigued by $49/month dashboards that require weeks of onboarding. Tools that deliver an instant answer in the browser (like MarginProof's 4 calculators) and hand off to a portable template convert faster with near-zero support overhead.
